scope: 55 explicitly named repositories in the supplied report: 52 main-list repositories and 3 backlog additions. This is not a re-audit of all 185 historical records.
method: GitHub repository metadata and code search, followed by default-branch trees when search was empty or rate-limited, targeted source/documentation reads, and final reads at captured commit SHAs. Search results were used for discovery, not as proof of absence.
limits: Static source and documentation review only. No installation, CI rerun, benchmark reproduction, production deployment, active-user, or payment verification. A 404 does not establish deletion. Evidence retrieved at a commit is not an adoption date.
